quote: Sample: I bought my first detective novel at the Wheeler stall before a night train, and finished it before dawn.
Sample: My father managed a stall for thirty years. He knew which passengers wanted which newspaper before they asked.
Sample: Every summer holiday began with one comic from the platform stall. Choosing it took longer than the journey.
Sample: As a young author, seeing my book on a railway stall felt like it had finally reached the whole country.
